confirmedFindings.title: Webhook Retry Backoff Inverts Event Delivery Sequence
confirmedFindings.body: Dispatching webhook retries independently without per-call FIFO sequencing causes retried `call.initiated` events to arrive after `call.terminated` has already been delivered, leaving customer CRM systems in a permanently stuck 'Ringing' state.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Enforce per-callId sequential queues so downstream events are not dispatched until prior events succeed or exhaust retries.
